items.title: Infrathon: a 24-hour benchmark where agents optimize real AI infrastructure; 135 of 150 runs were still improving late
items.summary: Allen AI, UW and Stanford release a benchmark of 25 real AI-infra tasks run on H100s with six agent configurations over 24 hours; rankings shift with the time horizon, and Claude Opus 5.5 found a KV-cache codec scoring 19.86 against 6.82 for a human-designed one.

items.title: dspy-wsp: a DSPy optimizer in which a frontier model edits a small model's weights directly
items.summary: Drew Breunig and Cmpnd release a prototype weight-space optimizer that plugs into DSPy like any other optimizer; the authors say about 5 to 10 dollars of frontier-model usage improved every decision model they tested.

doubt.pushback: One reply argues the gains came from an abliteration-like change rather than the model directly editing weights; unverified and not deep-read.

items.title: UGG: one model for video generation, depth estimation and camera pose
items.summary: A paper proposes a unified generative geometry model that handles video generation, depth and camera pose together instead of as separate tasks.
